scope: D2 filter investigation; no implementation/admission or visual acceptance

findings.cityPink3d: Active 3x3 weights sum16 but divide15; combine0.8 original+0.8 blurred; scanlines and two radial color mixes; final alpha1. A normalized alpha-preserving blur would be explicit project design, not shader equivalence.
findings.rgblur: Active per-channel direction scales from RGB mask; seven texture taps (three symmetric pairs+center); time/noise code inactive. Output alpha1. Plain unmasked directional blur is a component extraction, not the full active filter.
findings.crb: Root source read: sampled brightness controls candidate size; endpoint trials shrink while brightness difference>30. Do not describe as walking until an edge or admit edge detector from report prose.

next: Specify reusable normalized image filtering independently of fixed vignette colors, gain and opaque-only shader output; demonstrate image/mask composability. Choose contract before production code.
